finding: The repository had npm audit triage scripts and a local summary parser, but Security CI did not yet print the audit package summary during automated runs.

changes.summary: Added a non-blocking step that captures npm audit JSON and prints the triage summary before the main security gate.
Documented the non-blocking CI audit summary, the warning-only policy, and the updated operational checklist.

notes: The CI audit summary intentionally uses `|| true` so existing npm audit findings are visible but do not block until triage is complete.
The next dependency-fix phase should use the printed audit summary to update only affected packages, avoiding `npm audit fix --force`.
next_steps: Wait for the next Security CI/Vercel run and inspect the npm audit summary in logs.
Generate and commit package-lock.json after audited dependency pins are chosen.
Promote production npm audit into security:ci only after production findings are fixed or explicitly accepted.
